notes.title: Localization announcement
notes.content:
The development of the Steam version was carried over to Kagura Games.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1211830/Explorers_of_the_Abyss/
The Steam version will be available in English and Chinese.

notes.title: Steamでの発売は現状未定
notes.content:
Steamの審査に通らなったため、Steam版の発売は未定とします。

DLsiteやFanzaではリリース済みなので、そちらでご購入ください。
https://wargame.jp/?page_id=2060
